invariant: NoFutureRevisionEvidenceForging: Evidence cannot be recorded or pre-seeded for a future workspace revision that has not occurred
preconditions: Agent or caller invokes recordEvidence with workspaceRevision > currentRevision (e.g. R=2 when workspace is at R=0)
sequence: 1. Workspace initialized at R0; 2. Caller calls recordEvidence with workspaceRevision: 2, exitCode: 0, status: PASS; 3. Physical mutations advance workspace R0 -> R1 -> R2; 4. verifyCompletion called for R2; 5. Engine accepts pre-seeded R0 evidence as passing verification for R2, bypassing physical verification of mutations
alloy_verdict: VERIFIED on hardened model (UNSAT) / COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant (SAT)
expected: recordEvidence throws FUTURE_REVISION_FORBIDDEN when workspaceRevision > currentRevision
observed: recordEvidence accepted future revision and later completed R2 without fresh verification
patch: Enforce params.workspaceRevision <= this.currentRevision check in recordEvidence, throwing FUTURE_REVISION_FORBIDDEN on violation
post_fix_evidence: Vitest a6-verification-hardening.test.ts passes (Defect 1); 75/75 verification suite tests pass
limitations: Applies to VerificationEngine controller state; external distributed stores must pair with fencing tokens

invariant: NoRaceEvidencePollution: An asynchronous oracle dispatched at revision R cannot record a clean PASS if physical workspace mutations occurred during execution
preconditions: Oracle verification (oracle.verify) takes non-zero time (e.g. executing test suite in child process)
sequence: 1. Oracle starts execution at workspace revision R1; 2. Concurrently or during await oracle.verify, workspace mutates (trackPhysicalMutation) to revision R2; 3. Oracle finishes with exit code 0; 4. runOracle returns status: PASS, binding compromised test run to R1 and leaving caller unaware that workspace mutated mid-test
alloy_verdict: COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant a6-verification-mutant.als (SAT) / VERIFIED on specification (UNSAT)
expected: Evidence status is marked ERROR with WORKSPACE_MUTATED_DURING_VERIFICATION reason and exitCode >= 1
observed: runOracle returned status: PASS with clean reasons despite workspace mutating under it
patch: Detect this.currentRevision !== workspaceRevision in runOracle, mark status as ERROR, set exitCode to 1 if zero, and attach WORKSPACE_MUTATED_DURING_VERIFICATION reason
post_fix_evidence: Vitest a6-verification-hardening.test.ts passes (Defect 3); 75/75 verification suite tests pass
limitations: Requires physical mutations to be reported through trackPhysicalMutation; unmonitored external filesystem edits require snapshot checking

invariant: TruthfulFailureReporting: A failed oracle check at current revision must be reported as FAILED, never masked as STALE due to an earlier passing revision
preconditions: Test oracle passed at revision R1, workspace mutated to R2, and test oracle failed at R2
sequence: 1. Test oracle passes on R1; 2. Workspace mutates to R2; 3. Test oracle fails on R2 (exitCode: 1, status: FAIL); 4. verifyCompletion({ requiredOracles: ['TEST'] }) executes; 5. Loop checks if (earlierSuccess) before checking failedAtCurrent; 6. Engine outputs TEST_EVIDENCE_STALE from R1, completely omitting TEST_FAILED
expected: evalResult.reasons contains TEST_FAILED and does not mask failure as TEST_EVIDENCE_STALE
observed: evalResult.reasons contained TEST_EVIDENCE_STALE and omitted TEST_FAILED
patch: Prioritize failedAtCurrent check ahead of earlierSuccess check in verifyCompletion requiredOracles evaluation
post_fix_evidence: Vitest a6-verification-hardening.test.ts passes (Defect 2); 75/75 verification suite tests pass
limitations: Assumes oracles report non-zero exit codes or status !== PASS on failure

invariant: NoUnrepairedFailureCompletion: Completion cannot be granted if an unrepaired failed check exists at the current revision, even if requiredOracles is empty
preconditions: An oracle check fails at current revision, and verifyCompletion is called with empty or default requirements ({})
sequence: 1. Files mutated to R1; 2. Oracle check (e.g. BUILD or TEST) fails with exitCode 1; 3. Caller calls verifyCompletion({}) or verifyCompletion({ mutationRequired: true }); 4. Because requiredOracles was empty, verification loop was skipped; 5. Engine returned complete: true and reported VERIFICATION_COMPLETE
expected: verifyCompletion returns complete: false with UNREPAIRED_FAILURE / BUILD_FAILED
observed: verifyCompletion returned complete: true with VERIFICATION_COMPLETE
patch: Query latestEvidenceAtRevision for currentRev and block completion with ${oracle}_FAILED if any check remains un-repaired, regardless of requiredOracles filter
post_fix_evidence: Vitest a6-verification-hardening.test.ts passes (Defect 4); 75/75 verification suite tests pass
limitations: Only tracks checks recorded through VerificationEngine evidence history

invariant: AccurateEvidenceSlotAggregation: Evidence slot status must reflect all latest checks for that oracle at current revision and cannot show PASS when any check failed
preconditions: An oracle has multiple commands at current revision (e.g. unit tests and e2e tests), where one failed and one passed
sequence: 1. Execution records failing unit test at R1 (npm test -- unit, exit 1); 2. Execution records passing e2e test at R1 (npm test -- e2e, exit 0); 3. buildSlot selects only all[all.length - 1] (the e2e test) and marks slot.status = PASS; 4. assessCompletionEvidence correctly marks TEST as missing (via oracleSatisfied); 5. explainCompletion reports missing: [\TEST: PASS at R1 (exit 0)\"]"
expected: Slot status is FAIL and explainCompletion reports TEST: FAIL at R1
observed: Slot status was PASS and explainCompletion reported TEST: PASS at R1 in missing array
patch: Inspect all latest checks at currentRevision using latestEvidenceAtRevision and evidencePassed; mark slot status as FAIL if any check failed at current revision
post_fix_evidence: Vitest a6-verification-hardening.test.ts passes (Defect 5); 75/75 verification suite tests pass
limitations: Differentiates checks by command, criterionId, and target metadata keys
